description.text: Application Deadline The applicants can still apply for degree programs one month after the semester begins.

duration.text: The Religion at Capital Normal University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3694 USD/per year ￥ 26600 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6. Letter of guardian’s guarantee Letter of guarantee The guardian should write out his/her name, nationality, occupation and address (if an organization acts as the guardian, reference to the organization should be made clear).

requirements.text: Aged under 40 years old Applicant should hold Bachelor degree diploma or equivalent to a Chinese Bachelor degree diploma HSK level 7 or above
